summary: Sales executive with over a decade of business-to-business sales experience selling accounts receivable, collection, billing and healthcare services to physicians, hospitals and medical practices, plus commercial and consumer sales. Has prospected, closed and retained clients across multiple states, including territory and regional management roles, and has trained and supported new sales representatives. Scope has included territories spanning several Ohio and Kentucky markets and monthly placement volumes in the millions, with a record of growing client lists, profits and retention through CRM-driven account management.
